channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold seems vulnerable below $4,100 as USD recovers on Iran risks and Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone heading into the European session on Friday and seems vulnerable after struggling to build on a two-day-old move up above the $4,100 mark.

item.title: Euro: Upside risks after sharp Dollar shift – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole writes that EUR/USD broke above 1.150 as broad Dollar weakness persisted, even as the Euro underperformed some G10 peers despite stronger Eurozone data.

item.title: Ueda Speech: BoJ Governor speaks policy outlook after the expected interest rate hold
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda is addressing the press conference, explaining the reason behind leaving the key interest rate unchanged at 1.00% in the July policy meeting.

item.title: Swiss Franc holds losses following weaker Real Retail Sales
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 0.8070 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention and cautious BoJ stance – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur reports that Japan’s Ministry of Finance intervened in FX markets, with apparent US Treasury support, to address a weak Japanese Yen as Tokyo inflation stabilises around 2% with upside risks.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecast: Euro is testing trendline support at 0.8555
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is trading practically flat against the British Pound (GBP) on Friday, as bears kept testing the base of the ascending trendline from mid-July highs, around 0.8555, following Thursday’s reversal from 0.8585 highs.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Weakens below 1.3450 while technical uptrend stays intact
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in negative territory around 1.3445 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Heightened Middle East tensions and rising global oil prices provide some support to a safe-haven currency such as the US Dollar (USD) against the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: Indian Rupee hits fresh two-week high against US Dollar
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends the week-long rally against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday.

item.title: WTI falls to near $80.50 on profit-taking, increased traffic through Strait of Hormuz
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $80.50 during the early European trading hours on Friday. WTI tumbles as traders book some profits despite ongoing conflicts in the Middle East.

item.title: Asian stocks surge, led by KOSPI on AI optimism, Wall Street gains
item.description: Asian stock markets move higher on Friday, tracking overnight gains on Wall Street as a global rally in semiconductor stocks and renewed AI optimism lifted sentiment. Strong earnings from Microsoft and Amazon reinforced expectations for continued hyperscaler investment and resilient AI demand.

item.title: Canadian Dollar retreats on sliding oil prices as USD recovers on Fed bets, Mideast risks
item.description: The USD/CAD pair edges higher during the Asian session on Friday and, for now, seems to have snapped a three-day losing streak to the lowest level since June 17, touched the previous day.

item.title: Rare Japan-South Korea joint intervention lifts Yen and Won — Reuters
item.description: Japanese and South Korean officials stepped in to buy their currencies in the open market in what sources described as a rare and an unprecedented coordinated market intervention, possibly alongside the United States (US), Reuters reported on Friday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah loses ground following China PMI release
item.description: USD/IDR gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 18,120 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) struggles following the release of disappointing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data from China, Indonesia’s largest trading partner.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Weakens to near 1.1500 as 100-day SMA caps upside
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in negative territory around 1.1500 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The Euro (EUR) softens against the US Dollar (USD) as escalating tensions in the Middle East weigh on riskier assets.

item.title: Australian Dollar sticks to intraday gains as BoJ's on-hold decision keeps Yen pressured
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross builds on the previous day's goodish rebound from sub-111.00 levels, or the lowest since April 7, and gains strong positive traction during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD declines to near $58.40 as US Dollar regains ground
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down almost 1% to near $58.40 during the Asian trading session on Friday. The white metal faces selling pressure as the US Dollar (USD) rebounds slightly, attempting to snap a three-day losing streak.

item.title: 1%: Japanese Yen weakens as BoJ holds rates
item.description: USD/JPY rises after two days of losses, trading around 160.80 during the Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair continues to appreciate as the Japanese Yen (JPY) weakens following the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) decision to keep its short-term interest rate unchanged at 1.00%.

item.title: Euro rallies further above 185.00 against Japanese Yen after BoJ’s policy decision
item.description: The Euro (EUR) extends the intraday rally to near 185.20 against the Japanese Yen (JPY) after the Bank of Japan’ (BoJ) monetary policy decision during the Asian trading session on Friday. The BoJ has kept interest rates steady at 1%, as expected, with an 8-1 majority.

item.title: British Pound falls as US Dollar receives from internal FOMC policy split
item.description: GBP/USD loses ground after three days of gains, trading around 1.3450 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains support from a hawkish pause by the Federal Reserve (Fed) and an internal FOMC policy split.

item.title: Australian Dollar inches lower as China’s NBS Manufacturing PMI falls in July
item.description: AUD/USD inches lower after registering over 1% gains in the previous day, trading around 0.7020 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair remains subdued following the release of disappointing Chinese Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Climbs back above mid-160.00s as BoJ rate decision looms
item.description: The USD/JPY pair is seen building on the previous day's late recovery from sub-158.00 levels, or the lowest since May 14, and gaining positive traction during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar holds losses following China PMI data
item.description: NZD/USD loses ground after three days of gains, trading around 0.5870 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair remains subdued following the release of China's Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) data.

item.title: United States Dollar Index bounces off its lowest level since June 17, back above 100.00
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, gains some positive traction and climbs back above the 100.00 psychological mark during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: China's NBS Manufacturing PMI falls to 49.2 in July, Non-Manufacturing PMI eases to 49.0
item.description: China’s Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) fell to 49.2 in July, compared to 50.3 in the previous reading, China’s National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) reported on Friday. The reading came in below the market consensus of 50.0 in the reported month.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7894 vs. 6.7892 previous
item.description: On Friday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7894 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7892.

item.title: Euro softens to near 1.1500 as US-Iran war widens
item.description: The EUR/ USD pair loses ground to near 1.1515 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. The Euro (EUR) softens against the US Dollar (USD) amid risk-off sentiment and fears of wider war in the Middle East.

item.title: WTI holds losses around $82.50 on renewed US-Iran diplomatic hopes
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price remains in the negative territory for the second successive day, trading around $82.60 per barrel during the Asian hours on Friday. Crude oil prices have lost ground following renewed hopes for a diplomatic solution to the US-Iran conflict.

item.title: Japan’s Mimura: Always prepared to take suitable measures
item.description: Atsushi Mimura, Japan’s Vice Finance Minister for International Affairs and top foreign exchange official, said on Friday that he is in close contact with relevant authorities on foreign exchange, adding that the officials are always prepared to take suitable measures.

item.title: US President Donald Trump says Board of Peace has reached agreement for disarmament of Hamas
item.description: US President Donald Trump claimed his Board of Peace has reached an “historic agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas and all other armed groups in Gaza,”the Guardian reported on Friday.
